title: Codex automated Git operations trusted repository hook settings

cwe_mappings.note: Explicit classification in the vendor-authored CNA record.

summary: ZDI awarded Summoning Team USD 20,000 for this distinct Pwn2Own Berlin entry.
root_cause: Automated repository operations honored repository-local Git hook configuration outside the intended command-approval boundary.
impact: The vendor confirms possible user-privilege code execution when specially prepared local repository configuration is preserved. An ordinary Git clone does not preserve that configuration.
defensive_takeaways: Treat repository-local execution settings as untrusted input.
Apply execution policy to background tooling as well as user-visible agent commands.
